title: Jimeng MCP capability coverage
scope: Fixed action mappings and known feature gaps. No account identities, credentials, media, production deployment or past execution acceptance are distributed.
sharedEnablementRequirements: Configure and authorize your own official CLI accounts locally; no credentials or login state are supplied.
Web operations additionally require a user-provided private 0600 session file; CLI OAuth alone does not enable Studio web routes.
Only fixed actions and strict schemas are accepted; arbitrary CLI commands, URLs, headers and cookies are not tool inputs.
Writes default to dry-run; read-only and credit policies remain explicit local configuration.
Inspect the original job and target after an uncertain outcome; do not blindly create a new job to repeat a write.
Job status and business outcome are separate; completed transport does not certify persisted state or finished media.
